name: redshift
description: Amazon Redshift Overview This is an interface reference for Amazon Redshift.

subcommands.name: accept-reserved-node-exchange
subcommands.description: Exchanges a DC1 Reserved Node for a DC2 Reserved Node with no changes to the configuration (term, payment type, or number of nodes) and no additional costs.

subcommands.name: add-partner
subcommands.description: Adds a partner integration to a cluster.

subcommands.name: associate-data-share-consumer
subcommands.description: From a datashare consumer account, associates a datashare with the account (AssociateEntireAccount) or the specified namespace (ConsumerArn).

subcommands.name: authorize-cluster-security-group-ingress
subcommands.description: Adds an inbound (ingress) rule to an Amazon Redshift security group.

subcommands.name: authorize-data-share
subcommands.description: From a data producer account, authorizes the sharing of a datashare with one or more consumer accounts or managing entities.

subcommands.name: authorize-endpoint-access
subcommands.description: Grants access to a cluster.

subcommands.name: authorize-snapshot-access
subcommands.description: Authorizes the specified Amazon Web Services account to restore the specified snapshot.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-cluster-snapshots
subcommands.description: Deletes a set of cluster snapshots.

subcommands.name: batch-modify-cluster-snapshots
subcommands.description: Modifies the settings for a set of cluster snapshots.

subcommands.name: cancel-resize
subcommands.description: Cancels a resize operation for a cluster.

subcommands.name: copy-cluster-snapshot
subcommands.description: Copies the specified automated cluster snapshot to a new manual cluster snapshot.

subcommands.name: create-authentication-profile
subcommands.description: Creates an authentication profile with the specified parameters.

subcommands.name: create-cluster
subcommands.description: Creates a new cluster with the specified parameters.

subcommands.name: create-cluster-parameter-group
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Redshift parameter group.

subcommands.name: create-cluster-security-group
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon Redshift security group.

subcommands.name: create-cluster-snapshot
subcommands.description: Creates a manual snapshot of the specified cluster.

subcommands.name: create-cluster-subnet-group
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon Redshift subnet group.

subcommands.name: create-custom-domain-association
subcommands.description: Used to create a custom domain name for a cluster.

subcommands.name: create-endpoint-access
subcommands.description: Creates a Redshift-managed VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: create-event-subscription
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Redshift event notification subscription.

subcommands.name: create-hsm-client-certificate
subcommands.description: Creates an HSM client certificate that an Amazon Redshift cluster will use to connect to the client's HSM in order to store and retrieve the keys used to encrypt the cluster databases.

subcommands.name: create-hsm-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates an HSM configuration that contains the information required by an Amazon Redshift cluster to store and use database encryption keys in a Hardware Security Module (HSM).

subcommands.name: create-integration
subcommands.description: Creates a zero-ETL integration or S3 event integration with Amazon Redshift.

subcommands.name: create-qev2-idc-application
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Redshift Query Editor (QEV2) IAM Identity Center application.

subcommands.name: create-redshift-idc-application
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Redshift application for use with IAM Identity Center.

subcommands.name: create-scheduled-action
subcommands.description: Creates a scheduled action.

subcommands.name: create-snapshot-copy-grant
subcommands.description: Creates a snapshot copy grant that permits Amazon Redshift to use an encrypted symmetric key from Key Management Service (KMS) to encrypt copied snapshots in a destination region.

subcommands.name: create-snapshot-schedule
subcommands.description: Create a snapshot schedule that can be associated to a cluster and which overrides the default system backup schedule.

subcommands.name: create-tags
subcommands.description: Adds tags to a cluster.

subcommands.name: create-usage-limit
subcommands.description: Creates a usage limit for a specified Amazon Redshift feature on a cluster.

subcommands.name: deauthorize-data-share
subcommands.description: From a datashare producer account, removes authorization from the specified datashare.

subcommands.name: delete-authentication-profile
subcommands.description: Deletes an authentication profile.

subcommands.name: delete-cluster
subcommands.description: Deletes a previously provisioned cluster without its final snapshot being created.

subcommands.name: delete-cluster-parameter-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a specified Amazon Redshift parameter group.

subcommands.name: delete-cluster-security-group
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Redshift security group.

subcommands.name: delete-cluster-snapshot
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified manual snapshot.

subcommands.name: delete-cluster-subnet-group
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified cluster subnet group.

subcommands.name: delete-custom-domain-association
subcommands.description: Contains information about deleting a custom domain association for a cluster.

subcommands.name: delete-endpoint-access
subcommands.description: Deletes a Redshift-managed VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: delete-event-subscription
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Redshift event notification subscription.

subcommands.name: delete-hsm-client-certificate
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified HSM client certificate.

subcommands.name: delete-hsm-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified Amazon Redshift HSM configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-integration
subcommands.description: Deletes a zero-ETL integration or S3 event integration with Amazon Redshift.

subcommands.name: delete-partner
subcommands.description: Deletes a partner integration from a cluster.

subcommands.name: delete-qev2-idc-application
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Redshift Query Editor (QEV2) IAM Identity Center application.

subcommands.name: delete-redshift-idc-application
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Redshift IAM Identity Center application.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the resource policy for a specified resource.

subcommands.name: delete-scheduled-action
subcommands.description: Deletes a scheduled action.

subcommands.name: delete-snapshot-copy-grant
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified snapshot copy grant.

subcommands.name: delete-snapshot-schedule
subcommands.description: Deletes a snapshot schedule.

subcommands.name: delete-tags
subcommands.description: Deletes tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: delete-usage-limit
subcommands.description: Deletes a usage limit from a cluster.

subcommands.name: deregister-namespace
subcommands.description: Deregisters a cluster or serverless namespace from the Amazon Web Services Glue Data Catalog.

subcommands.name: describe-account-attributes
subcommands.description: Returns a list of attributes attached to an account

subcommands.name: describe-authentication-profiles
subcommands.description: Describes an authentication profile.

subcommands.name: describe-cluster-db-revisions
subcommands.description: Returns an array of ClusterDbRevision objects.

subcommands.name: describe-cluster-parameter-groups
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Amazon Redshift parameter groups, including parameter groups you created and the default parameter group.

subcommands.name: describe-cluster-parameters
subcommands.description: Returns a detailed list of parameters contained within the specified Amazon Redshift parameter group.

subcommands.name: describe-cluster-security-groups
subcommands.description: Returns information about Amazon Redshift security groups.

subcommands.name: describe-cluster-snapshots
subcommands.description: Returns one or more snapshot objects, which contain metadata about your cluster snapshots.

subcommands.name: describe-cluster-subnet-groups
subcommands.description: Returns one or more cluster subnet group objects, which contain metadata about your cluster subnet groups.

subcommands.name: describe-cluster-tracks
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the available maintenance tracks.

subcommands.name: describe-cluster-versions
subcommands.description: Returns descriptions of the available Amazon Redshift cluster versions.

subcommands.name: describe-clusters
subcommands.description: Returns properties of provisioned clusters including general cluster properties, cluster database properties, maintenance and backup properties, and security and access properties.

subcommands.name: describe-custom-domain-associations
subcommands.description: Contains information about custom domain associations for a cluster.

subcommands.name: describe-data-shares
subcommands.description: Shows the status of any inbound or outbound datashares available in the specified account.

subcommands.name: describe-data-shares-for-consumer
subcommands.description: Returns a list of datashares where the account identifier being called is a consumer account identifier.

subcommands.name: describe-data-shares-for-producer
subcommands.description: Returns a list of datashares when the account identifier being called is a producer account identifier.

subcommands.name: describe-default-cluster-parameters
subcommands.description: Returns a list of parameter settings for the specified parameter group family.

subcommands.name: describe-endpoint-access
subcommands.description: Describes a Redshift-managed VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: describe-endpoint-authorization
subcommands.description: Describes an endpoint authorization.

subcommands.name: describe-event-categories
subcommands.description: Displays a list of event categories for all event source types, or for a specified source type.

subcommands.name: describe-event-subscriptions
subcommands.description: Lists descriptions of all the Amazon Redshift event notification subscriptions for a customer account.

subcommands.name: describe-events
subcommands.description: Returns events related to clusters, security groups, snapshots, and parameter groups for the past 14 days.

subcommands.name: describe-hsm-client-certificates
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified HSM client certificate.

subcommands.name: describe-hsm-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified Amazon Redshift HSM configuration.

subcommands.name: describe-inbound-integrations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of inbound integrations.

subcommands.name: describe-integrations
subcommands.description: Describes one or more zero-ETL or S3 event integrations with Amazon Redshift.

subcommands.name: describe-logging-status
subcommands.description: Describes whether information, such as queries and connection attempts, is being logged for the specified Amazon Redshift cluster.

subcommands.name: describe-node-configuration-options
subcommands.description: Returns properties of possible node configurations such as node type, number of nodes, and disk usage for the specified action type.

subcommands.name: describe-orderable-cluster-options
subcommands.description: Returns a list of orderable cluster options.

subcommands.name: describe-partners
subcommands.description: Returns information about the partner integrations defined for a cluster.

subcommands.name: describe-qev2-idc-applications
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon Redshift Query Editor (QEV2) IAM Identity Center applications.

subcommands.name: describe-redshift-idc-applications
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon Redshift IAM Identity Center applications.

subcommands.name: describe-reserved-node-exchange-status
subcommands.description: Returns exchange status details and associated metadata for a reserved-node exchange.

subcommands.name: describe-reserved-node-offerings
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the available reserved node offerings by Amazon Redshift with their descriptions including the node type, the fixed and recurring costs of reserving the node and duration the node will be reserved for you.

subcommands.name: describe-reserved-nodes
subcommands.description: Returns the descriptions of the reserved nodes.

subcommands.name: describe-resize
subcommands.description: Returns information about the last resize operation for the specified cluster.

subcommands.name: describe-scheduled-actions
subcommands.description: Describes properties of scheduled actions.

subcommands.name: describe-snapshot-copy-grants
subcommands.description: Returns a list of snapshot copy grants owned by the Amazon Web Services account in the destination region.

subcommands.name: describe-snapshot-schedules
subcommands.description: Returns a list of snapshot schedules.

subcommands.name: describe-storage
subcommands.description: Returns account level backups storage size and provisional storage.

subcommands.name: describe-table-restore-status
subcommands.description: Lists the status of one or more table restore requests made using the RestoreTableFromClusterSnapshot API action.

subcommands.name: describe-tags
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tags.

subcommands.name: describe-usage-limits
subcommands.description: Shows usage limits on a cluster.

subcommands.description: Stops logging information, such as queries and connection attempts, for the specified Amazon Redshift cluster.

subcommands.name: disassociate-data-share-consumer
subcommands.description: From a datashare consumer account, remove association for the specified datashare.

subcommands.name: enable-logging

subcommands.name: enable-snapshot-copy
subcommands.description: Enables the automatic copy of snapshots from one region to another region for a specified cluster.

subcommands.name: failover-primary-compute
subcommands.description: Fails over the primary compute unit of the specified Multi-AZ cluster to another Availability Zone.

subcommands.name: get-cluster-credentials

subcommands.name: get-cluster-credentials-with-iam
subcommands.description: Returns a database user name and temporary password with temporary authorization to log in to an Amazon Redshift database.

subcommands.name: get-identity-center-auth-token

subcommands.name: get-reserved-node-exchange-configuration-options
subcommands.description: Gets the configuration options for the reserved-node exchange.

subcommands.name: get-reserved-node-exchange-offerings
subcommands.description: Returns an array of DC2 ReservedNodeOfferings that matches the payment type, term, and usage price of the given DC1 reserved node.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Get the resource policy for a specified resource.

subcommands.name: list-recommendations

subcommands.name: modify-cluster-snapshot
subcommands.description: Modifies the settings for a snapshot.

subcommands.name: modify-cluster-snapshot-schedule
subcommands.description: Modifies a snapshot schedule for a cluster.

subcommands.name: modify-cluster-subnet-group

subcommands.name: modify-custom-domain-association

subcommands.name: modify-endpoint-access
subcommands.description: Modifies a Redshift-managed VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: modify-event-subscription
subcommands.description: Modifies an existing Amazon Redshift event notification subscription.

subcommands.name: modify-integration
subcommands.description: Modifies a zero-ETL integration or S3 event integration with Amazon Redshift.

subcommands.name: modify-lakehouse-configuration

subcommands.name: modify-qev2-idc-application
subcommands.description: Modifies an Amazon Redshift Query Editor (QEV2) IAM Identity Center application.

subcommands.name: modify-redshift-idc-application

subcommands.name: modify-scheduled-action
subcommands.description: Modifies a scheduled action.

subcommands.name: modify-snapshot-copy-retention-period
